039.zh: 规定保和省Tubigon市镇现称Panadtaran小学的学校今后名称为Avelino Chagas市长小学的法案

039.en: An Act Constituting Sitios Calunyan, Ihawan, Kagsilihan, Monterico and Tagbinonga in the Municipality of Mahaplag, Province of Leyte, Into a Barrio of Said Municipality, to Be Known as Barrio San Juan
039.zh: 将莱特省Mahaplag市镇的Calunyan、Ihawan、Kagsilihan、Monterico与Tagbinonga小村组建为该市镇名为San Juan村的法案

039.en: An Act Reducing the Minimum Age of the Different Elective Local Officials by Amending Section Forty-Two of Batas Pambansa Blg. Tatlong Daan Tatlumpu't Pito, otherwise known as the Local Government Code
039.zh: 通过修订Batas Pambansa Blg. Tatlong Daan Tatlumpu't Pito（即《地方政府法典》）第42条，降低各类地方民选官员最低年龄的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Wawa Elementary School in San Agustin Village (Formerly Sitio Wawa-bukid) in Barangay Moonwalk, Municipality of Parañaque, Metro Manila, to San Agustin Elementary School
039.zh: 将马尼拉大区Parañaque市镇Moonwalk描笼涯San Agustin村（原Wawa-bukid小村）的Wawa小学更名为San Agustin小学的法案

039.en: An Act Converting the Sitios of Pinanhadsan and Km. 17, Municipality of Santa Fe, Province of Leyte, into Barrios of Said Municipality to be Known as the Barrios of Katipunan and Milagrosa, Respectively
039.zh: 将莱特省Santa Fe市镇的Pinanhadsan与Km. 17小村改设为该市镇名为Katipunan与Milagrosa的村的法案

039.en: An Act Naming the National Highway Beginning From Barangay Anayan, Municipality of Pili Up to the Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur, as the Governor Jose T. Fuentebella National Highway
039.zh: 将南甘马粦省自Pili市镇Anayan描笼涯至Lagonoy市镇的国道命名为Governor Jose T. Fuentebella国道的法案

039.en: An Act Authorizing and Approving the Transfer of the Franchise Granted to Melvic and Company, Incorporated by Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Seven Hundred Thirty-Eight in Favor of Jose S. Mercado of Cebu City
039.zh: 授权并批准将第3738号共和国法授予Melvic and Company, Incorporated的特许权转让给宿务市Jose S. Mercado的法案

039.en: An Act Providing that the Aguisan Bridge Recently Constructed in the Boundary of the Municipalities of Himamaylan and Binalbagan, Province of Occidental Negros, Shall Hereafter be Known as the Magsaysay Bridge
039.zh: 规定西内格罗斯省Himamaylan市镇与Binalbagan市镇交界处近期建成的Aguisan桥今后名称为Magsaysay桥的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Ifugao Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture in the Municipal District of Lamut, Subprovince of Ifugao, Mountain Province, to Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture
039.zh: 将高山省 伊富高次省 Lamut市镇区伊富高实验 Opportunity 农业学校的名称变更为Payon Bugan 实验 Opportunity 农业学校的法案

039.en: An Act Transferring the Barrios of Kisolon and San Vicente of the Municipality of Impasugong and the Sitio of Damay of the Municipality of Manolo Fortich to the Municipality of Sumilao in the Province of Bukidnon
039.zh: 将Bukidnon省Impasugong市镇的Kisolon村与San Vicente村以及Manolo Fortich市镇的Damay小村划归Sumilao市镇的法案

039.en: An Act to Convert the Sitios of Ilaya Labac, Matalisay, Pajo and Cacawan in Isla Verde, in the Municipality of Batangas, Province of Batangas, to a Barrio to be Known as Barrio San Antonio of the Same Municipality
039.zh: 将八打雁省Batangas市镇Isla Verde的Ilaya Labac、Matalisay、Pajo与Cacawan小村改设为该市镇名为San Antonio村的村的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Names of Mascarina Barrio School and Villa Gomez Barrio School in the Municipality of Quezon, Province of Quezon, to Pedro Cabangon Barrio School and Ulpiano Camacho Barrio School, Respectively
039.zh: 将奎松省Quezon市镇的Mascarina村学校与Villa Gomez村学校的名称分别变更为Pedro Cabangon村学校与Ulpiano Camacho村学校的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Names of the Caparan Primary School and Dalangin Primary School in the Municipality of Ipil, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, to Tiayon Primary School and DARol Moslem Primary School, Respectively
039.zh: 将南三宝颜省Ipil市镇的Caparan小学与Dalangin小学的名称分别变更为Tiayon小学与DARol Moslem小学的法案

039.en: An Act Declaring June 10 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Tarlac to be Known as "Danding Cojangco Day" in Commemoration of the Birth Anniversary of Eduardo "Danding" Murphy Cojangco, Jr.
039.zh: 宣布每年6月10日为打拉省特别非工作假日，名称为“Danding Cojangco日”，以纪念Eduardo“Danding”Murphy Cojangco, Jr.诞辰的法案

039.en: An Act Authorizing and Approving the Transfer of the Franchise Granted to the Evening News Publishing Co., Inc. by Republic Act Numbered Thirteen Hundred Thirty-Seven in Favor of the Inter-Island Broadcasting Corporation
039.zh: 授权并批准将第1337号共和国法授予Evening News Publishing Co., Inc.的特许权转让给Inter-Island Broadcasting Corporation的法案

039.en: An Act to Constitute the Sitios of Salokegue, Can-Abay, Soksokon, Capatagan, Danglay and Lologayan, All in the Municipality of Basey, Province of Samar, into a Barrio to be Known as Barrio May-et of the Same Municipality
039.zh: 将萨马省Basey市镇的Salokegue、Can-Abay、Soksokon、Capatagan、Danglay与Lologayan小村组建为该市镇名为May-et村的村的法案

039.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Five Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Construction of Memorial Monuments to Mark the Graves of Soldiers Buried at the Libingan ng mga Bayani in Fort William Mckinley, and Other Places
039.zh: 授权拨款50万比索，在Fort William Mckinley的Libingan ng mga Bayani及其他地点修建纪念阵亡士兵墓的纪念碑的法案

039.en: An Act Constituting the Sitios of Kay-Poo, Nabiling, Kahawanan, Apartahan and Kalimpay in the Barrio of Tigwi, Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, into a Separate Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Kawayanan
039.zh: 将马林杜克省Torrijos市镇Tigwi村的Kay-Poo、Nabiling、Kahawanan、Apartahan与Kalimpay小村组建为名为Kawayanan村的独立村的法案

039.en: An Act Authorizing the Reconstruction of a Gabaldon Type Schoolhouse in the Municipality of San Francisco, Province of Cebu, With the Private Funds of Mrs. Elena P. Maningo, and Naming the Same Quirico Maningo Elementary School
039.zh: 授权以Elena P. Maningo女士的私人资金在宿务省San Francisco市镇重建一所Gabaldon式校舍，并将其命名为Quirico Maningo小学的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Manila South-Road, Zapote-Alabang Section in the City of Muntinlupa and City of Las Pinas, Metro Manila, to Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar Avenue in Honor of the Late Congressman Felimon C. Aguilar
039.zh: 将蒙廷卢帕市与拉斯皮纳斯市Manila South公路Zapote-Alabang段更名为Felimon C. Aguilar众议员大道，以纪念已故众议员Felimon C. Aguilar的法案

039.en: An Act Amending Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Eighty-Seven, Entitled “An Act to Grant to Cotabato Light and Power Company, Incorporated, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat, and Power System in Cotabato, Cotabato”
039.zh: 修订第487号联邦法（即《授予Cotabato Light and Power Company, Incorporated在Cotabato, Cotabato经营电灯、热力与电力系统特许权》）的法案

039.en: An Act Naming the Portion of the Pan-Philippine Highway from Barrio Guintiguian, Municipality of Babatngon, Province of Leyte, to Barrio Pinamono-an, Municipality of Mahaplag of the Same Province as the Daniel Z. Romualdez Highway
039.zh: 将莱特省自Babatngon市镇Guintiguian村至同省Mahaplag市镇Pinamono-an村的泛菲律宾公路段命名为Daniel Z. Romualdez公路的法案

039.en: An Act Providing that the Street in the City of Zamboanga at Present Known as Bailen Street, from its Point of Intersection with Ignacio Magno Street to that with Governor Alvarez Avenue, Shall Hereafter be Known as La Purisima Street
039.zh: 规定三宝颜市现称Bailen街的街道，自与Ignacio Magno街交叉点至与Governor Alvarez大道交叉点一段，今后名称为La Purisima街的法案

039.en: An Act Extending the Life of the People's Homesite and Housing Corporation for a Period of Twenty-Five Years to Take Effect Immediately After the Expiration of the Present Life Term on January Twenty-Four, Nineteen Hundred and Seventy-Six
039.zh: 将People's Homesite and Housing Corporation的存续期延长二十五年，自1976年1月24日现有存续期届满后立即生效的法案

039.en: An Act Changing the Name of Ramonito P. Maravilla Sr. National High School in Barangay Estefania, City of Bacolod, Province of Negros Occidental to Romanito P. Maravilla Sr. National High School, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 9939
039.zh: 将西内格罗斯省巴科洛德市Estefania描笼涯的Ramonito P. Maravilla Sr.国立中学更名为Romanito P. Maravilla Sr.国立中学，为此修订第9939号共和国法的法案

040.en: An Act Further Amending Republic Act Numbered Forty Hundred Twelve, Entitled "An Act Granting Pototan Electric Light and Power Corporation a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Pototan, Province of Iloilo"
040.zh: 进一步修订第4012号共和国法（即《授予Pototan Electric Light and Power Corporation在伊洛伊洛省Pototan市镇经营电灯、热力与电力系统特许权》）的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing the National Resettlement and Rehabilitation Administration (Narra) to Expropriate the Hacienda Del Rosario, Situated at Valdefuente, Cabanatuan City, and Subdivide Said Hacienda into Lots to be Sold to Bona Fide Occupants Thereof
040.zh: 授权国家安置与康复署（Narra）征用位于Cabanatuan市Valdefuente的Hacienda Del Rosario，并将该庄园划分为地块售予其善意占用人的法案

040.en: An Act Extending the Term of the Franchise Granted to the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company Under Act Numbered Three Thousand Four Hundred and Thirty-Six, as Amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered Four Hundred and Seven, and for Other Purposes
040.zh: 延长第3436号法（经第407号联邦法修正）授予Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company的特许权期限，并为其他目的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing the Danao National Hospital in the Municipality of Danao, Province of Cebu, to Accept Donations in Any Form, Whether in Cash, Materials, Equipment or Medicines, from the Durano and Company, Inc. and the Universal Cement Company, Inc.
040.zh: 授权宿务省Danao市镇的Danao国立医院接受Durano and Company, Inc.与Universal Cement Company, Inc.以现金、物资、设备或药品等任何形式提供的捐赠的法案

040.en: An Act to Repeal Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Eighty-Nine, Entitled “An Act Granting Mauricio Palau, Narciso Fuertes and Juan Suarez a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Barotac Nuevo, Province of Iloilo”
040.zh: 废止第789号共和国法（即《授予Mauricio Palau、Narciso Fuertes与Juan Suarez在伊洛伊洛省Barotac Nuevo市镇经营电灯、热力与电力系统特许权》）的法案

040.en: An Act Renaming the Padre Burgos - Agdangan - Unisan - Pitogo - Macalelon - General Luna - Catanauan - Mulanay - San Francisco - San Andres - San Narciso - Buenavista National Road in Bondoc Peninsula in the Province of Quezon as the Miguel Suarez Highway
040.zh: 将奎松省Bondoc半岛的Padre Burgos - Agdangan - Unisan - Pitogo - Macalelon - General Luna - Catanauan - Mulanay - San Francisco - San Andres - San Narciso - Buenavista国道命名为Miguel Suarez公路的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Two Hundred Seven, Entitled “An Act Granting the San Fernando Electric Light and Power Co., Inc. a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of San Fernando, Province of Pampanga”
040.zh: 修订第3207号共和国法（即《授予San Fernando Electric Light and Power Co., Inc.在邦板牙省San Fernando市镇经营电灯、热力与电力系统特许权》）的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Order of the "Grand Cordon of the Order of Propitious Clouds" Offered to Him By the Chinese Government When He Was Vice-President of the Philippines
040.zh: 授权菲律宾共和国总统Elpidio Quirino阁下接受中国政府在其担任菲律宾副总统期间授予的“Grand Cordon of the Order of Propitious Clouds”勋章的法案

040.en: An Act Declaring Dr. Patrick B. Connon, Otherwise Known a Brother H. Gabriel Connon, FSC, President of De La Salle College, Manila, a Citizen of the Philippines, and Conferring Upon Him All the Rights, Duties, Privileges, and Prerogatives of Filipino Citizenship
040.zh: 宣布De La Salle College, Manila校长Patrick B. Connon博士（又称Brother H. Gabriel Connon, FSC）为菲律宾公民，并授予其菲律宾公民身份的一切权利、义务、特权与优遇的法案

040.en: An Act Amending Item (f), Section Two (f), (43 Quezon), Page 109; Projects B-421.43, Page 680, B-421.52, Page 678, B-421.62, Page 682, and B-421.64, Page 684, Appendix A; and Priority Numbered Twenty-Four, Page 79, Appendix B, of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen
040.zh: 修订第1613号共和国法第109页（43 Quezon）第2条（f）项（f）目、附录A第680页B-421.43、第678页B-421.52、第682页B-421.62与第684页B-421.64项目及附录B第79页优先项目第24号的法案

040.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Vito Cruz Street in the Districts of Malate and Singalong, City of Manila, and in the Municipality of Makati, Metro Manila, to Pablo de Leon Ocampo Street in Honor of Pablo de Leon Ocampo, Lawyer, Editor, Parliamentarian, Statesman and Nationalist
040.zh: 将马尼拉市Malate与Singalong两区及马尼拉大区Makati市镇的Vito Cruz街更名为Pablo de Leon Ocampo街，以纪念律师、编辑、议员、政治家与民族主义者Pablo de Leon Ocampo的法案

040.en: An Act Providing That the Registers of Deeds of the Provinces of Misamis Oriental, Agusan and Nueva Ecija Shall Be the Ex Officio Registers of Deeds for the Cities of Cagayan De Oro, Butuan and Cabanatuan, Respectively, While Said Cities Continue to Be the Capitals of Said Provinces
040.zh: 规定东米萨米斯省、Agusan与Nueva Ecija省的契约登记官分别兼任Cagayan De Oro、Butuan与Cabanatuan市的契约登记官，但以该等市继续为上述各省首府为限的法案

040.en: An Act Constituting the Sitios of Bobowa and Inakaran into Barrio Libertad, Sitios Campo Uno and Campo Dos into Barrio Sto. Niño, Sitios Balogo, Hagumayan and Hubas into Barrio Balogo, Sitios Guinodiongan and Pangdan into Barrio Guinodiongan, All of the Municipality of Capoocan, Province of Leyte
040.zh: 将莱特省Capoocan市镇的Bobowa与Inakaran小村组建为Libertad村，Campo Uno与Campo Dos小村组建为Sto. Niño村，Balogo、Hagumayan与Hubas小村组建为Balogo村，Guinodiongan与Pangdan小村组建为Guinodiongan村的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Decoration of “Grand Officer of the Legion of Honor of the Republic of France” Conferred Upon Him When He was Vice-President of the Philippines by the Government of the Republic of France
040.zh: 授权菲律宾共和国总统Elpidio Quirino阁下接受法兰西共和国政府在其担任菲律宾副总统期间授予的“Grand Officer of the Legion of Honor of the Republic of France”勋章的法案

040.en: An Act Declaring February Nineteen of Each Year as Doña Aurora Aragon Ouezon Day a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Aurora in Order to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Doña Aurora Aragon Quezon, the First President of the Philippine National Red Cross, and Foundation Day of the Province
040.zh: 宣布每年2月19日为Doña Aurora Aragon Quezon日，即奥罗拉省特别非工作假日，以纪念菲律宾国家红十字会首任主席Doña Aurora Aragon Quezon诞辰及该省成立纪念日的法案

040.en: An Act Officially Naming the Mandaue Causeway Located in the City of Mandaue, Province of Cebu, Stretching from the Corner of S.B. Cabahug St., Traversing the Tipolo Creek in Barangay Centro and the Mandaue Reclamation Area, Up to the Bridge Over the Mahiga Creek at the Cebu International Port, as Ouano Avenue
040.zh: 将宿务省Mandaue市自S.B. Cabahug街转角经Centro描笼涯Tipolo溪与Mandaue填海区至Cebu国际港Mahiga溪桥的Mandaue堤道正式命名为Ouano大道的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of Two Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Creation of the Cagayan Valley Agricultural High School in the Province of Cagayan as a Regional National Agricultural School of the Central Luzon Agricultural College Type to be Known as the Cagayan Valley National Agricultural School
040.zh: 授权拨款20万比索，在卡加延省设立Cagayan Valley农业中学，作为Central Luzon Agricultural College类型的区域国立农业学校，名称为Cagayan Valley国立农业学校的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Thirteen Hundred and Forty-Five, Entitled “An Act of Creating the National Marketing Corporation and Dissolving the Price Stabilization Corporation Appropriating Funds Therefor, and for Other Purposes.” as Amended by Republic Acts Numbered Sixteen Hundred One, Seventeen Hundred Ninety-One
040.zh: 修订第1345号共和国法（即《设立National Marketing Corporation并解散Price Stabilization Corporation、为此拨款并为其他目的法案》，经第1601号与第1791号共和国法修正）的法案

040.en: An Act Extending the Corporate Life of the Philippine National Railways for Another Fifty (50) Years, Further Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 4156, as Amended, Entitled "An Act Creating the Philippine National Railways, Prescribing Its Powers, Functions and Duties, and Providing for the Necessary Funds for Its Operation"
040.zh: 将Philippine National Railways的公司存续期再延长五十年，为此进一步修订第4156号共和国法（经修正，即《设立Philippine National Railways、规定其权力、职能与职责并为其运营提供必要资金》）的法案

040.en: An Act to Further Amend the First Paragraph of Section Fifteen of Article Eight of Republic Act Numbered Eleven Hundred and Thirty-Five, Entitled "An Act Establishing the Philippine Tobacco Administration, Defining its Objectives, Powers and Functions, and for Other Purposes," by Extending the Capitalization, and for Other Purposes
040.zh: 通过扩大资本，进一步修订第1135号共和国法第八编第15条第一段（即《设立Philippine Tobacco Administration、界定其目标、权力与职能并为其他目的》）并为其他目的法案

040.en: An Act Adopting the Honorable Millard E. Tydings, United States Senator From Maryland and the Honorable John Mcduffie, Former Member of the House of Representatives of the United States From the First District of Alabama, as Sons of the Philippines, and Conferring Upon Them All the Rights, Privileges and Prerogatives of Philippine Citizenship
040.zh: 接纳美国马里兰州联邦参议员Millard E. Tydings阁下与亚拉巴马州第一选区前联邦众议员John Mcduffie阁下为菲律宾之子，并授予其菲律宾公民身份的一切权利、特权与优遇的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Make Disbursements From the "Sugar Adjustment and Stabilization Fund" Created By Commonwealth Act Numbered Five Hundred and Sixty-Seven for the Establishment and Operation of Sugar Experiment Stations and the Undertaking of Researches With a View to Adjusting and Stabilizing the Sugar Industry.
040.zh: 授权菲律宾总统从第567号联邦法设立的“Sugar Adjustment and Stabilization Fund”中支出款项，用于设立与运营糖业试验站并开展研究，以调整与稳定糖业的法案

040.en: An Act Providing that the Highway from the City of Manila to the Municipality of Lingayen, Province of Pangasinan, Passing Through the Municipality of Tarlac, Province of Tarlac, and the Municipalities of Villasis, Urdaneta, Sta. Barbara, Calasiao, Dagupan, and Binmaley, All in the Province of Pangasinan, Shall Hereafter be Known as the Macarthur Highway
040.zh: 规定自马尼拉市经打拉省Tarlac市镇及邦阿西楠省Villasis、Urdaneta、Sta. Barbara、Calasiao、Dagupan与Binmaley各市镇至邦阿西楠省Lingayen市镇的公路，今后名称为Macarthur公路的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Section Two (k) of Commonwealth Act Numbered One Hundred Twenty, Entitled “An Act Creating the National Power Corporation, Prescribing its Powers and Activities, Appropriating the Necessary Funds Therefor, and Reserving the Unappropriated Public Waters for its Use,” as Amended by Section One of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Fifty-Eight
040.zh: 修订第120号联邦法第2条（k）项（即《设立National Power Corporation、规定其权力与活动、为此拨付必要资金并保留未拨用公有水域供其使用》，经第358号共和国法第1条修正）的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing Marcelina S. Aquino to Transfer, Assign, Sell or Mortgage in Favor of Any Banking or Financing Institution Her Franchises Under Republic Acts Numbered Six Hundred Ninety-Seven and Seven Hundred Fifty-Seven, to Install, Operate and Maintain Telephone Systems in the City of Butuan and in the Province of Agusan and the Municipalities and Municipal Districts Thereof
040.zh: 授权Marcelina S. Aquino将其依第697号与第757号共和国法享有的在Butuan市及Agusan省及其各市镇与市镇区安装、运营与维护电话系统的特许权转让、让与、出售或抵押给任何银行或金融机构

040.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Senate to Transfer From the Unexpended Balance of Paragraph Iv-special Purposes, Item 3, Page 10 of Republic Act Numbered Five Hundred Sixty-three, the Sum of Fifty Thousand Pesos to Letter (A)-Senate Electoral Tribunal, for Its Additional Expenses and of Its Members, Commissions, Delegates and Helpers, and Such Other Personnel as May Be Authorized By Said Tribunal
040.zh: 授权参议院议长从第563号共和国法第10页第Iv-特别用途段第3项未支用余额中拨出5万比索给（A）项参议院选举法庭，用于其及其成员、委员会、代表与助手以及该法庭可能授权的其他人员的附加费用

040.en: An Act Authorizing the Durano and Company, Inc. and the Universal Cement Company, Inc. to Widen and Concrete, at Their Own Expense, the National Highway Fronting Their Cement Plant in the Municipality of Danao, Province of Cebu, and the Municipal Streets of the Towns of Danao, Carmen and Catmon, All in the Province of Cebu, and to Concrete Such Other Public Improvements Therein as May be Designated by the Municipal Councils Thereof
040.zh: 授权Durano and Company, Inc.与Universal Cement Company, Inc.自费拓宽并铺设其宿务省Danao市镇水泥厂前的国道及宿务省Danao、Carmen与Catmon各市镇的市镇街道，并铺设其中由各市镇议会指定的其他公共改良工程

040.en: An act to aid the Mining Industry by providing for the waiver of, and/or extension of the period within which to perform, accomplish or comply with any term, condition, or stipulation required of locators, holders, lessees, or operators of mining claims or concessions, and of water rights and timber concessions connected with the Mining Industry, and the Condonation of Mining, Specific and Real Estate Taxes, under certain terms and conditions
040.zh: 通过免除和/或延长矿权地或采矿特许权以及与采矿业相关的水权与木材特许权的定位人、持有人、承租人、经营人应履行任何条款、条件或约定的期限，并免除采矿税、特定税与房地产税，以扶助采矿业的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Section One of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Entitled "An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Obtain Such Loans or Incur Such Indebtedness with the Government of the United States, its Agencies and Instrumentalities as May be Necessary to Cover Budgetary Deficits and Other Expenditures of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines for Rehabilitation and Other Purposes, and Appropriating the Necessary Funds Therefor"
040.zh: 修订第16号共和国法（即《授权菲律宾总统向美国政府及其机构与部门取得必要贷款或举借必要债务，以弥补菲律宾共和国政府预算赤字及其他支出用于复兴与其他目的，并为此拨付必要资金》）第1条的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Section One of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Two Hundred and Ninety, Entitled “An Act Appropriating the Sum of Three Million Eight Hundred Thousand Pesos, Out of the Proceeds of the Bond Issue Authorized by Republic Act Numbered One Thousand, to Finance the Re-Establishment and Rehabilitation by the Manila Railroad Company of its Cabanatuan Branch Extending from the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Bulacan, to the City of Cabanatuan”
040.zh: 修订第1290号共和国法（即《从第1000号共和国法授权发行的债券收益中拨出380万比索，资助Manila Railroad Company重建与修复其自布拉干省Plaridel市镇至Cabanatuan市的Cabanatuan支线》）第1条的法案

040.en: An Act Further Amending Section One Hundred Seven of Commonwealth Act Numbered One Hundred Forty-One, by Providing that When the Power to Sign Patents or Certificates for Land Granted Under Said Act is Delegated by the President to the Secretary and Under-Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Such Patents or Certificates Shall Bear the Official Seal of the Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources Instead of the Great Seal of the Republic of the Philippines
040.zh: 进一步修订第141号联邦法第107条，规定总统将依该法授予土地的专利或证书签署权下放农业与自然资源部长及副部长时，该等专利或证书应加盖农业与自然资源部官方印章而非菲律宾共和国国玺的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Section One of the Republic Act Numbered Eighty-One Providing a New Time Limit for the Waiver Of, and/or Extension of the Period Within Which to Perform, Accomplish or Comply With, Any Term, Condition, or Stipulation Required of Locators, Holders, Lessees, Operators of Mining Claims or Concessions, and of Water Rights and Timber Concessions Connected with the Mining Industry, and the Condonation of Mining, Specific and Real Estate Taxes, Under Certain Terms and Conditions
040.zh: 修订第81号共和国法第1条，为矿权地或采矿特许权以及与采矿业相关的水权与木材特许权的定位人、持有人、承租人、经营人应履行的任何条款、条件或约定，规定免除和/或延长履行期限的新期限，并在特定条款与条件下免除采矿税、特定税与房地产税的法案

040.en: An Act to Amend Act Numbered One Thousand Eight Hundred and Seventy Entitled, “An Act for the Purpose of Founding a University for the Philippine Islands, Giving it Corporate Existence, Providing for a Board of Regents, Defining the Board’s Responsibilities and Duties, Providing Higher and Professional Instruction, and for Other Purposes,” as Amended by Eliminating the Provisions Excluding the Alumni of the University of the Philippines Among Persons Who May be Conferred Honorary Degrees by the University
040.zh: 修订第1870号法（即《为菲律宾群岛创办一所大学、赋予其法人资格、规定董事会、界定董事会职责与义务、提供高等与专业教育并为其他目的法案》，经修正），删除将菲律宾大学校友排除于可被授予荣誉学位人员之外的规定的法案

040.en: An Act Renewing for Anther Twenty-Five Years the Franchise Granted to Gateway U.H.F. Television Broadcasting, Inc., Presently Known as Gateway Television Broadcasting Inc., and Doing Business Under the Name and Style of Hope Channel Philippines, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act 7223, Entitled: "An Act Granting Gateway U.H.F. Television Broadcasting, Inc., a Franchise to Construct, Install, Operate and Maintain for Commercial Purposed UHF Television Broadcasting Stations in the Philippines, and for Other Purposes"
040.zh: 将授予Gateway U.H.F. Television Broadcasting, Inc.（现称Gateway Television Broadcasting Inc.，以Hope Channel Philippines名义营业）的特许权再续展二十五年，为此修订第7223号共和国法（即《授予Gateway U.H.F. Television Broadcasting, Inc.在菲律宾为商业目的建设、安装、运营与维护UHF电视广播站特许权并为其他目的》）的法案

040.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Use Any Savings from the Appropriations for the Executive Department in the General Appropriation Act for the Fiscal Year Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Nine for the Operation of All Existing Normal Schools, for the Establishment and Operation of Additional Normal Schools, and for the Rehabilitation and Expansion of the Upi Agricultural School in Cotabato, the Bukidnon Agricultural School in Bukidnon, the Lagangilang Farm School in Abra and the Cabagan Farm School in Isabela
040.zh: 授权菲律宾总统动用1949财政年度总拨款法中行政部门拨款的任何节余，用于运营所有现有师范学校、设立与运营增设的师范学校，以及修复与扩建Cotabato的Upi农业学校、Bukidnon的Bukidnon农业学校、Abra的Lagangilang农场学校与Isabela的Cabagan农场学校的法案

040.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred and Four, Entitled "An Act to Provide for the Registration of the Claims of All Officers and Employees of the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, Its Branches and Instrumentalities and the Corporations Owned or Controlled By the Government and Those of the Free Local Civil Governments, Provincial and Municipal, Duly Organized for Purposes of Resistance Against the Enemy, to Salaries and Wages During the Enemy Ok Japanese Occupation of the Philippines and to Provide for the Manner of Their Settlement."
040.zh: 修订第304号共和国法（即《规定菲律宾联邦政府及其分支机构与部门、政府所有或控制的公司以及为抗敌而正式组织的自由地方民政政府、省与市镇政府的一切官员与雇员，在日军占领菲律宾期间薪金与工资债权的登记，并规定其清偿方式》）的法案

040.en: An Act Renaming the Barangay Bulwagan Elementary School in the Municipality of Hinoba-An, Province of Negros Occidental, as the Paz Vda De Escanilla Elementary School
040.zh: 将西内格罗斯省 Hinoba-An市镇 Bulwagan Elementary School描笼涯命名为Paz Vda De Escanilla 小学的法案

040.en: An Act Granting the Western Mindanao Lumber Company, Incorporated, a Temporary Permit to Construct, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Land-Based Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines
040.zh: 授予Western Mindanao Lumber Company, Incorporated在菲律宾境内建设、维护与运营私人点对点及陆基无线电通信收发台的临时许可的法案
